method: Orthographic all-triangle projected coverage; pixel is background only if no mesh triangle covers its ray. Fixed, order-derived masks; no depth/color/material reliance.

supportDatum.note: All three reported; robust estimates are descriptive and do not replace the global minimum.

front_large.maskDefinition: fixed order dimensions, centered at facade datum; straight jambs and semicircular crown, no fitted/shrunk mask

left_narrow.maskDefinition: fixed order dimensions, centered at facade datum; straight jambs and semicircular crown, no fitted/shrunk mask

limits: Coverage is geometric silhouette evidence, not an image-color test. Through-view opposite walls are included and can count as occlusion; a passing score is strong evidence of a clear ray, while a low score may include arch intrados/jamb perspective as well as a blocked opening.
